Status: Version 5 keeps every row of version 4 and adds the three S2-b events of spec 12 section 9 and spec 13 section 9.2 (FIN.DATA_MISSING, FIN.BALANCES_MISSING, FIN.STATEMENT_PENDING); and CMP.WARNING, the early warning of a covenant test, in the application only and never mandatory. OQ-6 of S2-b kept the early warning under CMP.BREACH; its text says a breach is recorded and an earlier version's text cannot change (the seeder only inserts), so the early warning has its own event and text. The new events, rules and texts are a proposed default written by an AI agent, to be reviewed by the treasury; no placeholder holds an amount. Earlier: Version 4 keeps every row of version 3 and adds the ten S2 events of spec 12 section 9 and spec 13 section 9.2 (FAC.EXPIRY_DUE, FAC.VALIDITY_UNCONFIRMED, FAC.REVISION_STATE, FAC.RESERVATION_ALERT, COL.RENEWAL_DUE, OBL.DUE, OBL.OVERDUE, OBL.REVIEW_OVERDUE, CMP.BREACH, ACC.FACILITY_ACCOUNT_FROZEN). The new events, rules and texts are a proposed default written by an AI agent, to be reviewed by the treasury; no placeholder holds an amount, since the facility data is confidential. The tenant may override a text (IsTenantOverride = 1).

Placeholders.source: fin.v_EarlyWarningMessageValues (db/static/051), by the MessageId of the notification request; a placeholder with Ar and En columns takes the column of the template's language
Placeholders.payload: The events outside FIN take their placeholders from the "values" object of their notification.requested payload, written by the application or the database in the same transaction as the event; a value may be a text or {"ar": ..., "en": ...}. No restricted value is ever a placeholder (BR-NTF-008): no identity, account or IBAN number.
